{{Current events|year=2024|month=12|day=4|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[4 December 2024 al-Mawasi attack]]
****Two [[Israeli Air Force]] strikes on an [[Gaza Strip evacuations|evacuation zone]] in [[Al-Mawasi, Rafah|Al-Mawasi]] in the southern [[Gaza Strip]] kill at least 20 refugees due to explosions and a subsequent fire that destroyed several refugee shelters. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/12/4/live-surge-in-israeli-attacks-on-gaza-city-casualties-overwhelm-hospital (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Israel–Hamas war]], [[Legality of Israeli settlements]]
***[[Israeli settler violence|Israeli settlers]] attack [[Huwara]] and [[Beit Furik]] in [[Nablus Governorate]], [[West Bank]], and [[arson|sets fire]] to several buildings and vehicles. The attacks are in retaliation to [[Palestinians]] destroying [[Israeli outpost|illegal farming outposts]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/4/israeli-settlers-mount-attacks-in-occupied-west-bank (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[2024 Syrian opposition offensives]]
***[[2024 Hama offensive]]
****Rebels capture the town of [[Al-Saan]] and the villages of [[Shaykh Hilal]] and [[Suruj]] in [[Hama Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.syriahr.com/%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b9%d8%b5%d8%a7%d8%a6%d8%a8-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%ad%d9%85%d8%b1%d8%a7%d8%a1-%d8%aa%d8%b7%d9%88%d9%82-%d9%85%d8%af%d9%8a%d9%86%d8%a9-%d8%ad%d9%85%d8%a7%d8%a9-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%87%d9%80/739174/ (SOHR)]
****Heavy fighting is reported in and around [[Hama]] as rebel forces enter the city and capture three neighbourhoods. [https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20241204-syrian-rebels-surround-key-city-hama-on-three-sides-war-monitor-says (France24)] [https://www.aljazeeramubasher.net/news/2024/12/5/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%B6%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%AE%D9%84-%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%A9 (Al Jazeera Mubasher)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Russia–NATO relations]]
***A [[Russian Navy]] warship fires warning shots at a [[German Air Force|German]] helicopter conducting a routine patrol over the [[Baltic Sea]], forcing the helicopter pilots to make evasive maneuvers. German Foreign Minister [[Annalena Baerbock]] condemns the incident as part of [[Russia]]'s [[hybrid warfare]] against [[NATO]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/russian-ship-fires-warning-shots-at-german-helicopter-in-baltic-sea/3413317 (Anadolu Agency)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**The [[Pakistan Army]] kills five jihadist insurgents and captures two others in a raid in [[Lakki Marwat District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-security-raid-militants-killed-northwest-3de03a47fb1bcfc29cf67830debd2fa0 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Cuba blackouts]]
**Another round of [[power outage|blackouts]] in [[Cuba]] leave millions of households without power. The [[Ministry of Science, Technology and Environment (Cuba)|energy ministry]] says that it is prioritizing restoring electricity to hospitals and water pumping facilities. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/cubas-electric-grid-collapses-after-power-plant-failure-2024-12-04/ (Reuters)]
*An [[Islamic Republic of Iran Air Force|Iranian Air Force]] [[trainer aircraft|training jet]] crashes in [[Fars province]], [[Iran]], killing both pilots. [https://en.irna.ir/news/85680401/Two-killed-in-training-jet-crash-in-southern-Iran (IRNA)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan relations]]
**[[Krygyzstan]] [[State Committee for National Security (Kyrgyzstan)|National Security]] official [[Kamchybek Tashiev]] and [[Tajikistan]] [[State Committee for National Security (Tajikistan)|National Security]] official [[Saimumin Yatimov]] announces that both countries have signed a agreement that would end 33-years of conflict at [[Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan border|the border]]. [https://thediplomat.com/2024/12/after-33-years-kyrgyzstan-and-tajikistan-announce-border-agreement/ (''The Diplomat'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Human trafficking in Germany]]
**[[Law enforcement in Germany|German police]], [[Directorate-General for External Security|French security services]], and [[Interpol]] conduct coordinated mass raids on an [[Iraq]]i-[[Kurds|Kurdish]] [[human trafficking]] network in [[North Rhine-Westphalia]] and [[Baden-Wurttemberg]], [[Germany]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/german-police-conduct-raids-on-alleged-people-smugglers/a-70957059 (DW)]
*[[Killing of Brian Thompson]]
**The CEO of American [[health insurance]] company [[UnitedHealthcare]] [[Brian Thompson (businessman)|Brian Thompson]] is [[assassinated]] by a masked gunman while attending a business conference in [[Manhattan]], [[New York City]], [[New York (state)|New York]], [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/unitedhealthcare-ceo-fatally-shot-ny-post-reports-2024-12-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[Feather River School shooting]]
**Two kindergarten students are critically injured in a suspected religious [[hate crime]] [[school shooting]] at a private [[Protestant]] school in [[Palermo, California]], United States, before the gunman commits [[suicide]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/12/05/us/school-shooting-california-kindergarteners.html (''The New York Times'')]
*Twelve [[Neo-Nazism|neo-Nazis]] are arrested in police raids across [[Italy]]. [https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/topnews/2024/12/04/blitz-polizia-contro-gruppo-neonazista-12-arresti_96f34193-34a2-4124-a360-fcdff3ba65d8.html (Ansa)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 South Korean martial law]]
**The [[National Assembly (South Korea)|National Assembly]] begins [[Attempted impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol|impeachment proceedings against Yoon Suk Yeol]] in response to Yoon's attempt to impose martial law in [[South Korea]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cn38321180et (BBC News)]
**The [[Korean Confederation of Trade Unions]] and other professional unions in [[South Korea]] announce a [[labor strike]] on December 5 and 6 in response to [[President of South Korea|President]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]]'s surprise declaration of [[2024 South Korean martial law|martial law]] yesterday, calling for Yoon's resignation. [https://www.mk.co.kr/en/society/11185227 (''Maeil Business Newspaper'')] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-12-03/korea-s-largest-union-calls-for-strike-to-reverse-martial-law?embedded-checkout=true (Bloomberg)]
**The [[South Korean won]] drops to a two-year low following Yoon Suk Yeol's declaration of martial law yesterday. Several [[exchange-traded fund|ETFs]] on the [[Korea Exchange]] also drop to a one-year low. [https://invezz.com/news/2024/12/03/south-korean-stocks-tumble-as-president-yeol-declares-emergency-martial-law/ (Invezz)]
**Foreign embassies in [[Seoul]] warn their citizens to stay away from [[political demonstration|mass demonstrations]], citing the possibility of violence and death. [https://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20241204050059 (''The Korea Herald'')]
*[[2024 French political crisis]]
**In [[France]], the [[Barnier government]] collapses after 331 of 577 deputies vote in favor of a [[no-confidence motion]], the first time since 1962 that the government has collapsed following a no-confidence motion. The [[left-wing politics|left]] subsequently calls on President [[Emmanuel Macron]] to resign and hold early presidential elections. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/french-lawmakers-set-vote-ousting-prime-minister-barnier-2024-12-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Georgian post-election protests]]
**[[Ahali]] party leader [[Nika Gvaramia]] is arrested in a [[Law enforcement in Georgia (country)|police]] raid on his office in [[Tbilisi]], [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]]. The arrest comes as [[Government of Georgia (country)|the government]] continues to crack down on the opposition in response to protests against delaying [[Accession of Georgia to the European Union|negotiations to join]] the [[European Union]]. More than 100 demonstrators are also injured during clashes with [[riot police]] in Tbilisi. [https://apnews.com/article/georgia-protest-opposition-election-russia-eu-43081aa9c939805ccb1c346c23535157 (AP)]
*[[2024 Namibian general election]]
**The [[Electoral Commission of Namibia|Electoral Commission]] of [[Namibia]] certifies the results of the general election, announcing [[Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah]] of the ruling [[SWAPO]] party as the new [[President of Namibia|President]], the first female president in the country's history. [https://www.thesouthafrican.com/news/politics/voting-result-namibia-elects-its-first-female-president-breaking-netumbo-nandi-ndaitwah/ (''The South African'')] [https://www.dw.com/en/namibia-elects-nandi-ndaitwah-as-first-woman-president/a-70952442 (DW)]
*Activists file a second [[Impeachment in the Philippines|impeachment]] complaint against [[Vice President of the Philippines|Philippine Vice President]] [[Sara Duterte]] over alleged misuse of government funds. [https://apnews.com/article/philippines-vice-president-duterte-impeachment-complaint-1edd5c533ae2f82d0cdad12bd5fd0c92 (AP)]
